naslov: AI Wars Ep. 11: Anthropic sets IPO price, Claude takes on Google & Microsoft
opis:
Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow at $70 to $78 per share, raising up to $64.4 billion publicly plus $26 billion in a private placement with Google, Nvidia, Microsoft and others, for a valuation of roughly $1 to $1.4 trillion. Trading could start as soon as next week, and each of the seven founders is selling about $250 million in shares. Meanwhile Claude turned into an office suite with Sheets, Whiteboards and Claude Data, with Meetings coming soon, putting it on Google Workspace and Microsoft turf.

AI Wars: the race between OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and the rest, told as a story. One episode a day.

naslov: e-means in FAISS: Meta's k-means replacement with 10x fewer passes | AI Tool #13
opis:
Meta FAIR's replacement for classic k-means: it clusters vectors (e.g. search embeddings) and reaches the same result in about a tenth of the passes over the data. It runs on CPU and GPU, with NumPy arrays and PyTorch tensors.

How to try it:
1. Install FAISS version 1.16.0 or newer.
2. Import faiss.contrib.e_means.
3. Run it on your own embeddings, e.g. to cluster notes or products by topic, and compare speed with regular k-means.

Price: free

Official link: https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/10/meta-fair-e-means-k-means-faiss/

naslov: Clive: the app that lets Claude set alarms on your iPhone | AI Tool #14
opis:

How to try it:
1. Open the Product Hunt page and download the app.
2. Check the link for how it connects to Claude.
3. Ask Claude something like "wake me up at 6:30 on weekdays".

Price: check the link

naslov: What is vibe coding? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Vibe coding means building software by describing what you want in plain words and letting AI write the code. This week, security firm Claroc found that share links from Grok Build, a vibe coding tool, were easy to guess. That exposed data from thousands of users, including medical test results, employee ID numbers and 24 apps built by SpaceXSI itself.
